name: Zombie Trailblazer
clause: Tap an untapped Zombie you control: Target creature gains swampwalk until end of turn.

needs.proposedSignature: { op: 'grant-landwalk', target: TargetSpec | Ref | 'creatures-you-control', subtypes: string[], duration: 'eot' | 'permanent' }  -- or give `grant-keyword` an optional `landwalk?: string[]` alongside `keywords`
needs.semantics: Grants a PARAMETERISED landwalk to a target. The bare `landwalk` keyword carries no land type, and characteristics.ts:545 builds the walk types from `attacker.def.landwalk` plus an anthem static's `landwalk` list only, so nothing an effect grants can ever make a creature unblockable today. The op would push the land types into the same per-object bag `staticMods().landwalk` already feeds.
needs.clause: Tap an untapped Zombie you control: Target creature gains swampwalk until end of turn.
